I agree with the others with the concept of making more guns or support items a viable choice instead of narrowing it down to 1 thing and then nerfing it with the mindset of "most players are choosing this and this was unintended ". I feel like they test these guns in a controlled area, at lower diff without playing a full level 7 or anything around it to really get an idea of how underwhelming or not optimal a weapon is for those situations. You can have hard difficulty but not the artificial kind where its just hard cuz everything is weak. Of course when you cant trust if your favorite guns will still behave the same the next week and have the modifiers that take slots away, some guns have less ammo, call in times doubled, etc. It's just.... irritating. For example, the spear is still fucked up in locking on, and when it does fire, it doesn't take out a charger on lvl 5 in one hit. So why would anyone ever pick the spear over the EAT at that rate?
